text:
Grandma Jones baked 5 apple pies and cut each pie into 8 pieces.  
Total pieces = 5 × 8 = 40 pieces.  
After the luncheon, 14 pieces remained.  
Pieces taken by guests = 40 - 14 = 26 pieces.

Answer: 26
reasoning:
We are given: Grandma Jones baked 5 apple pies. Each pie cut into 8 pieces. So total pieces = 5 * 8 = 40 pieces.

At the end of the evening, there were 14 pieces remaining. So pieces taken = total pieces - remaining = 40 - 14 = 26.

Answer: 26 pieces.
